title: My Cousin “Forgot” He Owed Me $2,000… So I Gave Him a Wedding Gift
hook: My cousin "forgot" he owed me $2,000… then got married
story: My cousin borrowed two thousand dollars from me and then, somehow, forgot. He needed it for rent, he said. He'd pay me back in a month. A month became a year. Meanwhile, he posted beach vacation photos, new sneakers, and a very expensive engagement ring. Every time I brought it up, he'd laugh and say, "Relax, I got you." He did not got me. Then I got invited to his wedding. So I brought a gift. A beautiful silver frame, wrapped in white paper. Inside the frame was the text message where he asked to borrow the money, and across the bottom, in gold letters, it said: "Paid in full. Congratulations. This is my gift to you." He opened it at the gift table, in front of his new in-laws. He turned bright red. His new father-in-law picked up the frame, read it very slowly, and asked him, "Two thousand dollars?" The next morning, I got a phone call from a number I didn't know. It was the father-in-law. He said, "I don't let family owe family." And he sent me two thousand dollars. So I got my money back. And now my cousin owes his father-in-law two thousand dollars… and that man does not forget.

Some debts follow you down the aisle. 💍
